scope.future_policy: Only explicitly fictional successors after the historical cutoff; no predictions of real future officeholders.
scope.claim: Seven verified starter officeholders across all four represented baseline rows, with partial historical chair chronology through currently verified leadership. This is research staging, not complete German party coverage or finished art.
scope.unrepresented_parties: PDS/Die Linke, AfD, BSW, East German CDU/SDP/LDPD/NDPD/Greens/Bündnis 90 predecessors and other minor parties require distinct lifecycle-aware game IDs.

ingestion.runtime_prerequisite: No automatic import. Expand empty legacy de_union slots with de_union_cdu then de_union_csu only under explicit save migration review. Party/co-party chairs do not automatically become Chancellor. Chancellor selection requires Bundestag election on presidential proposal; keep executive eligibility separately reviewed.
ingestion.people: Compatible Person records. Preserve existing helmut_kohl ID, exact name, birth and office_links; merge sources. Do not overwrite unrelated existing identities.
ingestion.parties: Compatible Party/Term fields only. Seven 1990 officeholders are not collapsed into four faces. No fictional composite leader.
ingestion.intervals: Half-open [from, until). Same-day chair handovers belong to the incoming leader. Year/month bounds express uncertainty and can conservatively leave display gaps; they are not known vacancies. Open terms only verified through reference_through.
ingestion.affiliations: Only researched office windows, not complete party membership.
ingestion.missing_life_dates: Omitted birth/death dates remain unverified; absence of died is not evidence that someone is alive.
ingestion.scope_clipping: Kohl and Vogel starter windows begin at 1990-01-01 as a scope clip, not original accession.

portrait_reference_audit.appearance: Broad heavy face and neck; high receding forehead; short side-parted gray-brown hair; large square silver metal glasses; clean-shaven. Gray-blue suit, white shirt and dark tie.
portrait_reference_audit.audit: Visually inspected. Official campaign-poster source dated 1989; not a separately dated 1990 photograph.

portrait_reference_audit.appearance: Second from left in profile: dense dark side-parted wavy hair, heavy dark eyebrows, broad long face, prominent straight nose; no glasses or facial hair. Dark suit, white shirt and dark tie.
portrait_reference_audit.audit: Visually inspected. Hans Modrow is at right and Franz Bertele far left; do not substitute either face.

portrait_reference_audit.appearance: Foreground center leaning forward: swept-back thick silver-gray hair with high receding temples; broad rectangular face, strong straight nose and jaw; dark thick-rim rounded-square glasses; clean-shaven, dark suit and light shirt.
portrait_reference_audit.audit: Visually inspected. Far-left foreground man is Franz Bertele; do not use his face.

portrait_reference_audit.provenance: German Bundestag image 2320136, Alfred Hennig / Color Press.
portrait_reference_audit.license: Restricted archive photograph; no free commercial redistribution license established. Reference only, do not ship photo.
portrait_reference_audit.appearance: High bald domed crown with thin gray curling hair at sides and back; blue-gray eyes, arched pale brows, prominent long nose, rounded cheeks and slight closed-mouth smile; no glasses or facial hair. Gray suit, finely striped blue-white shirt, dark diagonal-striped tie, white pocket square.
portrait_reference_audit.audit: Visually inspected. Archive labels January 1, 1990, which may be a year-only placeholder; reference deliberately retains year precision.

portrait_reference_audit.appearance: Left foreground: dark medium-length wavy hair with loose center/side part, thin metal glasses, rounded face, clean-shaven; dark blazer and open white shirt.
portrait_reference_audit.audit: Visually inspected. Scene dated by congress attribution; 2023 metadata is digitization. Do not substitute the bald man in turquoise standing behind.

portrait_reference_audit.audit: Visually inspected. Scene dated by congress attribution; 2023 metadata is digitization.

research_issues.detail: SPD's own 2019/2020 yearbook ends Schäfer-Gümbel's acting service on 30 September, contrary to handbook's 6 December. Primary party record takes precedence.
Party election results dated 30 May 2026 identify Wolfgang Kubicki as chair, succeeding Christian Dürr. No extrapolation from 2025.
